title: Label file-override forced routes distinctly
summary: Route evidence should report file-override forced remux/encode decisions as file override decisions, not folder policy decisions.
reason: A completed remux caused by exact routing.profile=remux file overrides displayed route_reason_code=folder_policy_force_remux and reason text saying folder policy forced remux, even though no library folder policy was configured.
behavior_before: Any forced route hint was labeled folder_policy_force_encode or folder_policy_force_remux, including exact per-file overrides.
behavior_after: Forced route hints whose reason starts with file override now use file_override_force_encode or file_override_force_remux and matching reason text while folder policy labels remain unchanged.
